_readme: Shop settings for /kindling/shop.html. See Strategy/Kindling/shop-setup.md. checkout.mode: 'preorder' (reservation form, no payment), 'shopify' (cart permalink to your Shopify store), or 'stripe' (Stripe Payment Links, one product per checkout).
status: First run ships winter 2026. Pre-orders are reservations; nothing is charged until we ship.

products.name: Kindling: Embers
products.blurb: Everything you need to start. Questions, confessions, touch, play, dares, and the wild cards that bend the rules. Heat 1 to 5, so it works for a first date or a tenth anniversary.

products.name: Wildfire
products.blurb: The big ones. Take a pole class and perform the routine. Reverse roles for a week. Hotel night as strangers. Naked Twister. Claim them now, live them later.

products.name: Slow Burn
products.blurb: Intimacy, the long way around. Read to them in the bath. Wash their hair. Plan the date with riddles. Undress each other one minute per item.

products.name: After Dark
products.blurb: Kink, power, sensation, and roleplay, without judgment. For couples, throuples, and groups. Negotiation cards come first, and every card has its own aftercare line.

products.name: The Whole Fire
products.blurb: Embers plus all three expansions, together in a bigger keepsake box with a numbered first-run card. The gift that makes the group chat go quiet.
